title: pvERFHDF5datareader
body:
## pvERFHDF5datareader

Reads ESI Result Format files stored in HDF5 (.erfh5), as written by ESI structural and crash solvers, into a partitioned dataset collection. A file holds stages (top-level groups; the "post" link names the default stage), each with constant data (mesh connectivity, nodes) and singlestate time states; Stages, Blocks and Variables choose what is read. Multistate data are not supported.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Variable names are offered in lower case because the reader treats them case-insensitively; use the lower-case form.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `ERFHDF5datareader`. Identity: `sources/ERFReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Blocks` | Names of the blocks stored in the ERF HDF5 file to load; the available names are listed by the file itself. Listing names replaces ParaView’s current selection, and unlisted blocks are not read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the ERF reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Stages` | Names of the stages (result sets) stored in the ERF HDF5 file to load; the available names are listed by the file itself. Listing names replaces ParaView’s current selection, and unlisted stages are not read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Variables` | List of variables to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvERFHDF5datareader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
